label: in-sample: Train years 2022-24, from the operator's census at one-lot natural prices; the screen decides
inputs: the operator's direction census, Train years 2022-24 only (sha256 of its sorted 'path sha256' manifest)
how: one long call, one lot, entered every qualifying session at the entry time (lots overlap), struck nearest the delta target and exited at 15:55 ET on the hold's last session; scored by the lane's own bar on the census's Train years

expiry.2-5: 2-5 days to expiry at entry, covering the exit session
expiry.6-10: 6-10 days to expiry at entry, covering the exit session
expiry.nearest: the nearest listed expiry on or after the exit session

gate.ivlow: 10-day at-the-money implied vol below its own median over the prior 60 sessions (same minute)
gate.contango: 10-day implied vol above 3-day implied vol (short-dated term structure in contango)

lessons: THE UNIT DECIDES THE SHAPE: 0.20 DELTA, 2-5 SESSIONS, EXPIRY WITHIN ABOUT 10 DAYS. Every passing cell is a 0.20-delta call held 2, 3 or 5 sessions on an expiry of at most 10 days (nearest covering, 2-5 or 6-10 DTE). E5 (the unit) is the most-failed rule: no 0.40 or 0.50-delta call fits at today's prices, a 0.30-delta call fits only at 2-3 sessions (mostly IWM) and then loses on costs, and no 8-session hold passes. 23 of the 30 passers fit only borderline, so take the 0.20-delta strike and the nearest covering expiry.

ALWAYS-IN PASSES E1; A GATE THAT SITS OUT 2022 FAILS E3. All 30 passers are in the market in all three Train years, 2022 included: 12 enter every session, 14 under one volatility filter (implied vol below its 60-session median, or 10-day above 3-day implied vol) and 4 under both. The price-trend gate is out of the market in 2022 in 416 of 448 cells, but the trades it still takes there lose (t below -1, or a loss over half the in-market years' mean), so it fails E3 in 381 of 448 cells and passes none; contango AND trend fails E3 in 443 of 448. Stacking both volatility filters thins 2022 below 60 entry sessions (E4) in 308 of 448 cells; 4 pass, all 5-session holds entered at 15:30. Enter EVERY qualifying session (lots overlap; do not wait for the last lot to close): the frequency floors (40+ trades on 20+ days, 60+ entry sessions, exposure at least half the busiest year's) need it.

COSTS DECIDE THE ROOT AND THE SHORTEST HOLD. IWM calls lose at 1.5x the half-spread in 765 of 784 cells (P1) and none pass; 0.20-delta 2-session holds keep under half their 1.0x profit at 1.5x in 197 of 224 cells (R3), so only 4 pass. SPY and QQQ at 3-5 sessions are the robust core. Every passer has a losing in-market year (E2 false for all 30): the profit is leveraged index drift, so the D2 screen, not this map, decides.
